correctness.rationale: On A=lambda I_2, both naive XTrace and XNysTrace basic estimators reduce to B_i=lambda rank(P_-i)+lambda||(I-P_-i)omega_i||^2; Nyström with Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse equals lambda times the range projector even for repeated sign columns. Independent sign probes have exactly two unoriented mutually orthogonal lines. For k>=3, all k lines equal (2 of 2^k line patterns) yields all B=lambda; exactly one minority (2k patterns) yields one B=3lambda and k-1 B=2lambda; all remaining patterns yield B=2lambda. Hence the exact joint law for (T_hat,e_hat), MSE lambda^2 2^(1-k)(1+1/k), proxy E e_hat²=lambda²2^(1-k)/k, basic-estimator pair correlation 1/2, calibration k+1 and strict one-stage false-stop formula for 0<delta<1/2. Independent exact Fraction enumeration for k=3..8 reproduces the three masses and statistics. A zero proxy is not a certificate; no extrapolation to normalized probes or multistage stopping.

Other Hutch++ and jackknife methods have different dependencies.

value.rationale: This is a deliberately minimal but natural supported input/discrete sampling scenario, exposing a zero posterior proxy with 50% trace error at explicit positive probability even though the mean estimate is unbiased. The exact full joint law calibrates a widely used heuristic estimator, identifies a concrete failure mode of an advertised adaptive test, and defines the precise boundary of that example. Not merely a code check or arbitrary matrix entry.
